title: The continuous harvester was dead for about three days and reported nothing but a warning
symptom: 35 consecutive iterations logged 'harvest_new_datasets not available' and 'this iter found 0 new slugs (registry now 71)'.
root_cause: The job imported harvest_new_datasets as a module-level function when it is a method on DatasetDiscovery; the ImportError was swallowed by try/except and the handle set to None.
correction_made: The broken import removed and the method called on the instantiated object, with the exception logged rather than swallowed.
